subject: Re: Service schedule update needed
text: Hi Priya, following up on our earlier call, I would like clearer information about the service schedule. Our priorities have shifted because the access road will be under repair starting next week. With that change, I need to know if installation can begin before Thursday or whether the crew must wait until the paving is finished. Please send the earliest available dates, any fees for rescheduling, and what preparation you need from our side. I also need to confirm whether the service includes replacing the gravel strip near the gate, since that section was not shown in the original estimate. If the new timeline affects the neighbor parking area, let me know today so we can notify residents before notice is posted. A brief email with answers will be enough, but please avoid vague timelines because we must coordinate deliveries and gate access. Also include crew leader contact numbers if available.
